faq.q: How much does The Fast Law Firm charge?
faq.a: The Fast Law Firm publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does The Fast Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: The Fast Law Firm does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking.

faq.q: Where does The Fast Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: The Fast Law Firm publishes one office, in Manhattan. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at The Fast Law Firm?
faq.a: The Fast Law Firm names 14 attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 3 of 14 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 10 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way.

faq.q: Are the case results The Fast Law Firm publishes verified?
faq.a: No. The Fast Law Firm publishes three case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about The Fast Law Firm?
faq.a: The Fast Law Firm scores 58 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, entity registration, website and footprint. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
